mapper.select: SELECT layer AS name, COUNT(*) AS count FROM osm_feature GROUP BY layer
SELECT sub_type AS name, COUNT(*) AS count FROM osm_feature WHERE layer = #{layer} GROUP BY sub_type ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 30

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count, COALESCE(SUM(ST_Length(CAST(geom AS geography))), 0) AS length_meters, COALESCE(SUM(ST_Area(CAST(geom AS geography))), 0) AS area_square_meters FROM osm_feature WHERE layer = #{layer} AND geom && ST_MakeEnvelope(#{minLon}, #{minLat}, #{maxLon}, #{maxLat}, 4326)
